children: Effective Sept. 17, 2026, M&T Bank Corporation will increase its prime lending rate from 6.75% to 7.00%.
Higher benchmark lifts loan pricing and NIM on variable-rate products; could slow loan demand.
Timing helps gauge near-term NIM trajectory and resets on floating-rate loans.

This is a routine repricing move aligned with broader rate conditions and peers, affecting near-term NIM and borrower costs. A broader catalyst would require management commentary on NIM/loan growth impact or similar moves by major peers confirming industry-wide shifts.
